quest.title: Thesis Defense Practice
quest.description: Having obtained the device, Layla still wishes to practice for her upcoming thesis defense...

talks.objective: Go to the House of Daena to practice
Go to the House of Daena to practice

dialogues.speaker: Azzam
dialogues.text: (There's nothing to worry about... right?)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you know about "The Great Machine"?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Could you talk about quadruple-orbit shift?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Can you briefly describe the application of the law of triple-orbit shift calculation?

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: Okay, I should get started on those notes. If there's anything you're curious about, you may go ahead and ask now. I can answer you as I write! I'm used to multi-tasking.

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: Oh, and I have to ask a favor. When you give the notes to her later, please don't tell her about my existence.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why's that?

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: Hmm, well, she's always been in a fragile state. If she knew that there was another "Layla" who's always taking care of everything...

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: She might feel like everything she's ever worked for is pointless, and that could lead to some demoralizing thoughts.

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: She's a resilient girl, but no matter how resilient she may be, no one can hold up to criticism and torment from themselves.

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: If her condition grows any worse, it's possible that I might cease to exist as well. Then there wouldn't be anyone to help her.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: But she's not doing very well now, either.

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: She's getting better, though, isn't she? It's apparent how hard she's working now.

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: She's my source of knowledge. I'm merely the representation of how she would be if she were rested and healthy.

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: I believe that she's one of the best, even in a place like the Akademiya, where geniuses come by the handful.

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: But growth is a process and shouldn't be rushed. I will always believe in and support her.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's good that she has you, or she might've already hit rock bottom.

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: Hahaha, believe me, even if she were to end up at rock bottom, she'd find a way to somehow laugh it off as one of her silly mistakes and climb her way out.

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: That's the kind of person she is.

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: Alright, I've written down all the possible questions that I think the advisers might ask. Next, I'll put together a few words of encouragement for her.

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: I'm not going to sign it, obviously. Oh, and don't forget about our agreement.

dialogues.speaker: Azzam
dialogues.text: You're quite welcome. It makes me happy to see my equipment being used to its potential.
